infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: StatFlow accesses your photos so you can upload player profile images and share game photos with your team.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: StatFlow uses your camera to scan player photos or capture profile images for your sports tracking. Photos are stored locally on your device and are only visible to you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: StatFlow uses your microphone for voice notes about game stats and player observations.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your data will be used to deliver personalized ads that support StatFlow and keep the app free. This helps us continue improving your sports tracking experience.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you share them with your friends.

plugins.userTrackingPermission: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized ads and help support the app.
